| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Output** `output` | Filtered back projection | Sinogram, Back projection without filter, Filtered back projection | Which stage to show. The sinogram is resized to the image, with the angle across and the position along the detector down. |
| **Angles** `angles` | 180 | 2 to 720 | How many projection angles, spread evenly over 180 degrees. |
| **Filter window** `window` | Ramp | Ramp, Shepp-Logan, Cosine, Hamming, Hann | The window that multiplies the ramp filter, for the filtered back projection. |
| **Channels** `channelScope` | Brightness only | RGB, Brightness only | Which part of the color image the filter changes. |
